title_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Shitet Njesi Komerciale Buze Rruge!
description_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Shitet Njesi Komerciale Buze Rruge! Kompleksi ka akses te menjehershem ne rruget kryesore te Laprakes dhe Kryqezimit te Don Bosko. Prona ka nje planimetri te shfrytezuar maksimalisht dhe shume te rregullt open space 296.37m2 dhe eshte i pajisur me tualet dhe ballkone. Ndodhet ne katin e 1 te nje objekti te ri shume prane Gjykates Administrative dhe Spitalit Ushtarak. Zona ka levizshmeri te larte dhe ambienti ka mundesi reklamimi pasi ka nje fasade xhami ne te gjithe perimetrin e prones e pershtatshme per dyqan, zyra, showroom, klinike, laborator etj. Disponojme opsione me metra te ndryshem. Mundesi blerje post parkimi me vlere ekstra (-1) 21.000 Euro dhe ⁠(-2) 18.500 Euro.
title_en: In Don Bosco, a commercial unit for sale on the side of the street!
description_en: In Don Bosco, a commercial unit for sale on the side of the street! The complex has immediate access to the main roads of Lapraka and Don Bosco Crossing. The property has a maximally utilized and very regular open space layout of 296.37m2 and is equipped with a toilet and balcony. It is located on the 1st floor of a new building, very close to the Administrative Court and the Military Hospital. The area has high mobility and the environment has the possibility of advertising as there is a glass facade around the perimeter of the property, suitable for shops, offices, showrooms, clinics, laboratories, etc. We have options with different meters. Possibility to purchase parking post with extra value (-1) 21,000 Euro and ⁠(-2) 18,500 Euro.
